title: Begruessungen und Vorstellungen
objective: Learn to greet people, introduce yourself and others, and say goodbye in German.
explanation: In German, greetings vary by region and time of day. The formal 'Sie' is used with strangers, colleagues, and authorities, while 'du' is used with friends, family, and children.
examples: Hallo, ich heisse Anna. - Hello, my name is Anna.
Freut mich, dich kennenzulernen! - Nice to meet you!
grammarFocus: Present tense of 'sein' (to be): ich bin, du bist, er/sie/es ist, wir sind, ihr seid, sie/Sie sind

guidedPractice.prompt: How do you ask 'What is your name?' (formal)?

independentPractice.prompt: Write a short dialogue introducing yourself to a new classmate.
List 5 different greetings in German and when to use them.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Hallo, ich heisse Lukas. Ich komme aus Berlin. Und du? Wie heisst du?'
readingTask: Read: 'Maria sagt: Guten Morgen! Ich bin Maria. Wer bist du? Paul sagt: Hallo Maria, ich bin Paul. Freut mich!'
speakingTask: Record yourself introducing yourself in German.
writingTask: Write 3 sentences: introduce yourself, say where you're from, ask someone their name.
reviewSummary: Today you learned: greetings, how to introduce yourself, and the formal vs informal distinction.

title: Das Alphabet und die Zahlen
objective: Learn the German alphabet, numbers 0-100, and how to spell your name.
explanation: The German alphabet has 26 letters plus Ae, Oe, Ue, and ss. Numbers 1-20 are unique; from 21: einundzwanzig (ones-and-tens).

vocabulary.example: Das A ist der erste Buchstabe.

grammarFocus: Numbers: 0 null, 1 eins, 2 zwei ... 20 zwanzig, 21 einundzwanzig. Letter ss = doppel-s.

guidedPractice.prompt: Spell your own surname in German.
What special letters does German have?

independentPractice.prompt: Write the numbers 1-20 in German.
Spell 5 German cities in German.

speakingTask: Say your phone number, house number, and age in German.
writingTask: Write 5 numbers in digits and words: 14, 33, 47, 52, 89.
reviewSummary: You learned the German alphabet (26 + Ae Oe Ue ss), how to spell, and numbers 0-100.

title: Meine Familie
objective: Describe your family members, use possessive articles, and talk about age.
explanation: Family vocabulary uses possessive articles: mein/meine (my), dein/deine (your), sein/seine (his), ihr/ihre (her). Articles change with gender.
examples: Ich habe eine Schwester und einen Bruder.
grammarFocus: Possessive articles: mein/meine, dein/deine, sein/seine, ihr/ihre. Nominative case.

independentPractice.prompt: Write 5 sentences about your family using possessive articles.
Draw a family tree and label all members in German.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'In meiner Familie gibt es vier Personen.'
readingTask: Read: 'Anna hat eine grosse Familie. Ihr Vater ist Arzt. Ihre Mutter ist Hausfrau.'
speakingTask: Describe your family in 3-4 sentences. Record yourself.
writingTask: Write a paragraph about your family: names, ages, professions.
reviewSummary: You learned family vocabulary, possessive articles, and family discussion.

title: Im Restaurant
objective: Order food and drinks, understand a menu, and pay the bill.
explanation: Use 'Ich moechte...' (I would like) or 'Ich haette gern...'. 'möchten' is a special modal verb.
grammarFocus: Verb 'moechten': ich moechte, du moechtest. Accusative: einen Kaffee (m), eine Cola (f), ein Wasser (n).

independentPractice.prompt: Create a dialogue between customer and waiter.
List 5 things you can order in a cafe.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Guten Abend. Ich moechte einen Tisch fuer zwei Personen.'
readingTask: Menu: Suppe 4,50 Euro, Schnitzel 12,80 Euro, Salat 6,90 Euro.
speakingTask: Role-play ordering a meal (greeting, order, pay).
reviewSummary: You learned restaurant vocabulary, 'moechten', and dining phrases.

title: Nach dem Weg fragen
objective: Ask for and give directions, understand basic location prepositions.
explanation: Use 'Entschuldigung, wo ist ...?' or 'Wie komme ich zu ...?' Key words: geradeaus, links, rechts.

vocabulary.example: Der Bahnhof ist um die Ecke.

grammarFocus: Prepositions with dative: zu + dem = zum, bei + dem = beim.

guidedPractice.prompt: Ask where the train station is.
How to get to the museum?

independentPractice.prompt: Draw a simple map and write directions from A to B.
Write a dialogue asking for and giving directions.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Wie komme ich zum Bahnhof? Gehen Sie geradeaus, dann rechts.'
readingTask: Read: 'Der Supermarkt ist nicht weit. Gehen Sie geradeaus.'
speakingTask: Give directions from your home to the nearest shop.
writingTask: Write directions from the station to the city center.
reviewSummary: You learned how to ask for and give directions using location prepositions.

title: Perfekt: Ueber die Vergangenheit sprechen
objective: Form and use the Perfekt tense to talk about past events.
explanation: Perfekt uses haben/sein + past participle. Most verbs use haben; motion/state change verbs use sein. Regular: ge-stamm-t.
examples: Ich habe gestern einen Film gesehen.
grammarFocus: Perfekt: haben/sein + Partizip II. Verb at position 2, participle at end. sein: motion verbs (fahren, kommen, gehen).

independentPractice.prompt: Write 5 sentences about yesterday using Perfekt.
List 5 verbs with haben, 5 with sein.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Gestern bin ich um 7 Uhr aufgestanden. Ich habe gefruehstueckt.'
readingTask: Read: 'Am Wochenende habe ich meine Oma besucht. Wir haben Kuchen gegessen.'
speakingTask: Tell what you did last weekend using Perfekt.
writingTask: Write 8 sentences about your last vacation using Perfekt.
reviewSummary: You learned Perfekt tense: haben/sein + past participle.

title: Beim Arzt: Koerper und Gesundheit
objective: Describe symptoms, name body parts, basic doctor conversation.
explanation: Use 'Ich habe...' for symptoms, 'Mir tut ... weh' for pain. Accusative for body parts, dative for conditions.
examples: Ich bin seit drei Tagen krank.
grammarFocus: Accusative with haben, Dative with wehtun: Mir tut der Kopf weh.

guidedPractice.answer: Ich bin seit zwei Tagen krank.

independentPractice.prompt: Write a doctor-patient dialogue.
Label 10 body parts in German.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Guten Tag, Herr Doktor. Mir tut der Hals weh.'
readingTask: Read: 'Der Arzt fragt: Wo tut es weh?'
speakingTask: Role-play at the doctor: describe your symptoms.
writingTask: Write a sick note to your boss.
reviewSummary: You learned body parts, describing symptoms, and doctor visit vocabulary.

title: Einkaufen: Kleidung und Farben
objective: Shop for clothes, describe items by color/size, compare prices.
explanation: Use 'Ich suche...' (I'm looking for...), 'Haben Sie...?' Colors take adjective endings matching noun gender.
examples: Haben Sie das in Groesse M?
grammarFocus: Adjective endings: ein blaues Kleid (n), eine rote Hose (f). Comparisons: guenstig - guenstiger - am guenstigsten.

guidedPractice.prompt: Say 'I'm looking for a blue dress.'
Ask 'Do you have this in size M?'
guidedPractice.answer: Haben Sie das in Groesse M?

independentPractice.prompt: Write a shopping dialogue.
List 10 clothing items with articles.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Ich suche eine warme Jacke in Groesse L.'
speakingTask: Describe an outfit you're wearing. Record.
writingTask: Write about shopping for a specific item.
reviewSummary: You learned shopping, colors, sizes, and adjective endings.

title: Mein Arbeitstag
objective: Describe daily work routine using separable prefix verbs and modals.
explanation: Separable prefix verbs: prefix moves to the end. Modal verbs: main verb infinitive at clause end.
examples: Die Arbeit faengt um 9 Uhr an.

vocabulary.example: Der Kurs faengt um 10 Uhr an.

grammarFocus: Separable prefix: prefix at end. Modal: modal at position 2, infinitive at end.

independentPractice.prompt: Write your daily routine (8 sentences) with separable verbs.
Make 5 modal verb sentences.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Ich stehe um 6:30 auf, fruehstuecke und fahre zur Arbeit.'
readingTask: Read: 'Maria muss Ueberstunden machen. Sie kann nicht zum Sport gehen.'
speakingTask: Describe a typical work day. Use 3 separable verbs.
writingTask: Write an email about your work schedule.
reviewSummary: You learned separable verbs (aufstehen, anfangen) and modal verbs.

title: Feste feiern: Geburtstag und Traditionen
objective: Talk about celebrations, give presents, describe German traditions.
explanation: 'Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!' is the standard birthday wish. Germans give gifts and celebrate with family.
examples: Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie.
grammarFocus: Dative with 'schenken': Ich schenke dir (dat) ein Buch (acc). 'Zum' = zu + dem.

independentPractice.prompt: Write a birthday invitation.
Describe a celebration in your culture.

listeningTask: Read aloud: 'Liebe Anna, ich lade dich zu meinem Geburtstag ein.'
readingTask: Read: 'In Deutschland feiert man Weihnachten am 24. Dezember.'
writingTask: Write a thank-you note for a birthday gift.
reviewSummary: You learned celebration vocabulary, dative with 'schenken', and traditions.
